model_reason: its pre-registered test (2021-2024 portal windows, 311 successful transfers) tied every baseline: recall at 10 0.148 vs. transfer rating 0.142, raw production 0.153, profile only 0.151 (random 0.045); edges -0.005 to +0.005, each 90% interval spanning zero. The system and fit terms add nothing detectable over ranking players by quality alone
proj_reason: its QB, RB and WR projections beat both simple baselines (last season's yards; last season's share) in a 2021-2025 backtest, but those seasons were also used to find and fix bugs, so the clean test is the 2026 season (scored in January 2027); its TE projections tied the baselines

tier_rules.1: Power-conference starter with above-average production, or a former 4-5 star recruit producing above replacement

tier_rules.3: Group of Five rotation player, or a former 4-5 star recruit with little production
tier_rules.4: FCS player, or a thin sample
